The Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) has decided to extend Palantir’s contract to provide the federated data platform (FDP) – the software that links different healthcare providers – for two more years rather than exercise a break clause that would have let them axe it next spring. item.title: Birds battling jet lag: Manx shearwaters suffer jet lag impacting homeward flights; could lead to serious consequences for inexperienced navigators
item.description: Recent research highlights that Manx shearwaters returning from foraging encounters navigational challenges akin to human jet lag.
